description: Legacy CRM cut-over created duplicates, blank owners, overwritten sources and lost deal links.
Four short links (Instagram bio, a podcast episode, a YouTube guide and a LinkedIn launch post) carry missing, unregistered or off-taxonomy UTM parameters.
Broad-audience Meta campaign launched; lead volume rose while qualification fell.
Bulk email moved to a new sending subdomain without warm-up or DKIM alignment; bounces and complaints rose and inbox placement fell before the enrollment deadline.
A landing-page release stripped UTM parameters from the webinar registration form.
Community-access provider returned HTTP 503 for six hours.
